command: cargo +1.98.1 test -p rrrah-dedup --features decode --test ico_dib --test decode --test pages --test raw_selected --test cache_interpretation
scope: Authored 24/32-bit DIB-backed two-entry ICO: independent primary RGB, partial alpha, bottom-up AND mask, quality rank and metadata, pixel/memory/frame count/out-of-range refusals, managed memory release. Native selected-frame path now checks reported image_count against max_frames; fingerprint domain v7 prevents reuse of prior admission semantics.
original_failures: Initial test used private pixel accessor; corrected to public rgba API before execution.
DIB pixel test passed but frame-count cap test exposed native ICO count not constrained by the prior TIFF-specific bound. New general post-decode reported-count guard added.
limitations: Native count guard is after native decoding and relies on reported metadata; does not bound all directory/parser work before decode.
Finite 24/32-bit DIB fixture, not full ICO/CUR or palette/mask grammar qualification.
